name: Pier Sixty-Six
positioning: Long-running waterfront resort in Fort Lauderdale for boaters and families, with a large spa built around hot and cold therapies
best_for: Spa and wellness travelers who want a sauna ritual, snow room and therapeutic pool on site
Families who want a kids' club while parents relax by the pool or try water sports

facts.text: For over 60 years, the resort has offered a destination in Fort Lauderdale.
Pier Sixty-Six describes itself as a gathering place for boaters, dreamers and adventurers.
Zenova Spa & Wellness at Pier Sixty-Six is a 13,000-square-foot spa.
Zenova has treatment rooms, a Couples Spa Suite, a full-service salon and the Co-Ed Via Aquae.
The Sensory Shower combines hot and cold therapy, chromotherapy, aromatherapy and oxygenation.
The Vitality Pool is Zenova's signature therapeutic pool.
The Technogym-powered Resort Fitness Center is open 24/7 for resort guests and club members, with a dedicated Movement Studio for wellness classes.
Scheduled wellness and fitness classes range from yoga and meditation to Pilates and strength training.
Pier Explorers daily experiences include hands-on art and STEM activities and imaginative play.
Childcare through partner itavi is available Monday to Friday for children 3 months and up.

highlights.text: The spa's Snow Room is kept at 10 to 14 degrees Fahrenheit and gives off alpine forest scents; the hotel calls it the region's first authentic Snow Room.
The Ceremonial Sauna is inspired by Europe's Aufguss saunas and offers guided rituals led by a traditional Sauna-Meister, with sound therapy and aromas.
The Pier Explorers Kids' Club blends play, learning and exploration, while parents can relax by the pool or enjoy water sports.
The weekly schedule includes a Floating Morning Meditation in the Adult Pool.

considerations.text: Zenova Spa & Wellness is open exclusively to resort guests and club members.
Guests must be at least 18 years old to book spa services.
WhataHotel notes this is a historic property with older infrastructure.
